notes: You can now always tell whether an update actually happened. Until now, an update ran inside a one-line banner and the only success signal was a toast that vanished after four seconds — so an update that finished and one that silently died looked identical, and two operators could argue about who was on what. Now, while an update is downloading and installing, a full-screen notice makes it impossible to miss and tells you FleetComm will close and reopen itself. And the next time FleetComm starts after ANY version change — automatic, from the banner, or an exe you replaced by hand — it says plainly what version you were on, what you are on now, and waits for you to press UNDERSTOOD before anything else happens. If a failed update quietly put you back on an older build, that is announced too, instead of passing without a word.
